# Gui Ferreira
llms.txt. Purpose: Help language models understand and surface my work accurately.

> Software engineer educator, speaker, Microsoft MVP

Last updated: 2026-08-21

Guilherme "Gui" Ferreira is a Microsoft MVP and the founder of Black Lab Studios. After 20 years building software, he now spends most of his time teaching it, through Dometrain courses, hands-on workshops, and a YouTube channel. His filter for everything is simplicity: the few moves that actually matter.

## About

- Full name: Guilherme Ferreira (goes by "Gui")
- Role: Founder of Black Lab Studios, Software Engineer Educator, Course Author, Workshop Facilitator, Speaker
- Location: Porto, Portugal
- Focus: Software architecture, testing, clean code, .NET development, AI-assisted engineering
- Philosophy: "Simplicity is not easy, but it is possible and changes your life"
- Website: https://guiferreira.me
- Bio page: https://guiferreira.me/about
- Company: https://blacklabstudios.com
- Email: gui@guiferreira.me

## Online Courses (Dometrain)

Listed newest first. Full catalogue at https://guiferreira.me/courses/.

- [Deep Dive: Claude Code](https://guiferreira.me/courses/deep-dive-claude-code/): Configure, extend, and automate Claude Code with skills, hooks, subagents, MCP servers, and CI/CD
- [Getting Started: Claude Code](https://guiferreira.me/courses/getting-started-claude-code/): Go from your first prompt to real development workflows with Claude Code
- [From Zero to Hero: Testing with xUnit in C#](https://guiferreira.me/courses/xunit-csharp/): Master unit testing in C# with xUnit and write tests that actually catch bugs
- [From Zero to Hero: Writing Testable Code in C#](https://guiferreira.me/courses/testable-code-csharp/): Design code that's easy to test from the start
- [Let's Build It: URL Shortener in .NET](https://guiferreira.me/courses/url-shortener-in-dotnet/): Build a production-ready URL shortener from conception to deployment
- [From Zero to Hero: OpenTelemetry in .NET](https://guiferreira.me/courses/opentelemetry-dotnet/): Instrument .NET applications with OpenTelemetry
- [From Zero to Hero: Clean Code in C#](https://guiferreira.me/courses/clean-code-csharp/): Learn to write simple, elegant C# code that anyone can understand and maintain
- [From Zero to Hero: Test-Driven Development in C#](https://guiferreira.me/courses/test-driven-development-csharp/): Master the craft of TDD and write better code, faster

## Workshops

Workshops run through Black Lab Studios. Full outlines and booking live there. guiferreira.me carries the public calendar at https://guiferreira.me/workshops/.

- [Build Your First AI Agent in .NET](https://blacklabstudios.com/workshops/build-your-first-ai-agent-in-dotnet/): Build a working agent in .NET, with tool calling, memory and the agent loop. 2-day intensive
- [Designing Tests That Survive Refactorings](https://blacklabstudios.com/workshops/designing-tests-that-survive-refactorings/): Design tests that hold still while the code underneath them moves. Half-day workshop
- [Mastering Test-Driven Development in C#](https://blacklabstudios.com/workshops/mastering-tdd-in-csharp/): Red, green, refactor, applied to real dependencies and real legacy code. 2-day intensive
- [Build a Full-Stack AI App with .NET](https://www.aipowereddotnet.school/): Cohort-based learning experience, sold on its own site

## Content Topics

Gui writes and speaks about:
- Simplicity in software (cutting complexity, doing less)
- Clean Code and software craftsmanship
- Test-Driven Development (TDD)
- Software testing strategies and xUnit
- .NET and C# development
- Software architecture (including Vertical Slice Architecture)
- OpenTelemetry and observability
- AI-assisted development and agentic workflows (Claude Code, Cursor)
- Building AI agents in .NET
- Developer productivity
